title: FAQ: Evergreen Account
summary: This FAQ explains the Evergreen Account’s monthly environmental impact report delivery, what purchases qualify for tree planting/carbon offsets, and how refunds change eligible spend and offset totals (reflected in the next update). It also covers referral rules: the referred person must deposit at least $750 within 60 days, referral eligibility starts after a 45-day tenure calculated from the date the customer opened their first Rho-Bank checking account.
